info.title: Turn A Gundam
info.synopsis: L'opera ha dietro di sé una storia piuttosto particolare che merita di essere quanto meno accennata. Nel 1999 la Sunrise, ed in particolare il franchise di Gundam, attraversavano un delicato momento. Erano appena stati archiviati: - Un fiasco commerciale ovvero Gundam X. - Un trionfo commerciale ovvero il film di Gundam Wing/Endless Waltz. - Un trionfo di critica/pubblico con la conclusione della serie OAV 08thMS Team. l'unica cosa che accomunava queste 3 produzioni era il fatto che il maestro Yoshiyuki Tomino, creatore di Gundam, non era stato minimamente coinvolto nella loro realizzazione. Con il prepararsi del ventennale della nascita di Gundam, la Sunrise decise di fare le cose in grande e ha richiamato Tomino alla direzione di una nuova serie Gundam. Il maestro ha avuto praticamente carta bianca e ha reinventato un Gundam assolutamente inedito pur citando in moltissimi punti le altre serie. In primis è la prima serie non UC fatta da Tomino e il nome ne è sintomatico dal momento che il simbolo della A rovesciata (Turn A appunto) significa, per chi non è particolarmente avvezzo a simboli matematici, "per ogni". Il titolo vero e proprio in effetti dovrebbe essere "Per ogni Gundam". TAG è, in teoria, la serie che le riassume tutte quante, presenti, passate e future. E' ambientata in un futuro lontanissimo dove la terra e la sua gente hanno attraversato un periodo del quale non si ha più memoria denominato 'L'età oscura'. Da non molto la civiltà si è risvegliata dal suo torpore e capisce di essere all'alba di una nuova era: una nuova rivoluzione industriale. Eh sì perché il livello di tecnologia/civiltà in cui vivono i terrestri nell'anno 2345 CC (anno di ambientazione della serie) è più o meno quello della terra dei primi del '900. Il problema è che i terrestri si sono dimenticati del fatto che sulla luna sono rimasti, e nel frattempo evoluti, moltissimi altri terrestri che hanno viceversa mantenuto una tecnologia avanzatissima. I moonrace hanno deciso che è giunto il momento di valutare un possibile ritorno sulla terra e mandano, quasi come se fossero delle cavie, tre ragazzini in esplorazione. Il loro compito è quello di mescolarsi con la gente comune e rendersi conto se è possibile un ritorno pacifico degli esuli lunariani sulla terra.

tvdb.synopsis: Kihel (Dianna) and Corin stop by at a nearby village. A mountain is discovered which may contain more mobile suits and both sides decide to go after it. One of Harry's underlings reports to him the sighting of Dianna and Corin. Loran finds them. Dianna hopes to use the Sacktrager space route to return to the moon. The village holds an Earth/Moonrace celebration which includes a float of the Turn A Gundam. Corin sees it and attacks it. Harry arrives. They trick Corin into thinking he defeated the real Turn A Gundam, and he leaves.

tvdb.synopsis: Kihel (Dianna) and Loran convince Harry to do some farming so as to experience what is like to be on Earth. The two later leave together. The Suicide Squad reaches the mountain, where the Moonrace is excavating mobile suits. A Moonrace officer, Ralfa, discovers that the mountain contains several nuclear weapons. Dianna and Kihel reunite and switch back to their original places. Dianna and Harry convince Kihel to stay with them. The Gallop and Red Team also rush towards the mountain. Ralfa's pleas for the fighting to stop are ignored. Gavane takes several nuclear bombs with him and fights with the Red Team. The nuclear bombs detonate, lighting up the sky for miles around.

Loran and the others encounter her and Quoatl, king of Adeska who says their people saw a vision of a nucelar blast. He agrees to help Loran after they fight and tells them of their legend of the Ades branch. Guin plans to fire the Willghem's mega beam cannon if Loran and the Suicide Squad can't take Manupichi by morning. Another Adeskan named Taruka confronts them, and everyone is thrown in a dungeon.

tvdb.title: The Taking of Manupichi
tvdb.synopsis: Joseph meets up with Mayalito who doesn't believe Quoatl to be a cowardly king. The Adeskans demand Quoatl pick up a sword and fight Taruka, but he refuses. Joseph arrives and provides a distraction, and Quoatl finally fights Taruka. Quoatl had refused earlier challenges because Taruka wasn't ready to become king. Quoatl and Mayalito help attack the Dianna Counter soldiers while the Suicide Squad attacks their cannons. Kihel tries to stop the firing of the Willgehm's beam cannon. Planted bombs destroy the cannons, along with assistance from Taruka. Quoatl and Mayalito sacrifice themselves. Taruka becomes the new king and encourages Loran to head to space.

tvdb.title: Fly! Into the Stratosphere
tvdb.synopsis: Midgard prepares the Gendarme to head to space. At Manupichi, the mass driver is revealed. Harry approaches the Gendarme in his Sumo but is unable to board it. Miran and Phil argue on the Soleil about what to do. The Willgehm prepares for takeoff, but Poe attacks. Loran fights them in the Turn A Gundam and is helped by Harry. The Willgehm takes off, and is helped by the Turn A Gundam and Sumo, making it to Sacktrager in space.

tvdb.title: Sackträger
tvdb.synopsis: The Willgehm docks with Sacktrager. The Gendarme is also docked there. Harry gets on the Willgehm and despite some of the crew's hesitancy speaks with Kihel. Midgard sends out forces to attack the Willgehm. Harry, Loran and Sochie try to trick Midgard and sees that he is using Dianna as a shield. Harry is able to install surveillance on the Gendarme. Dianna and Kihel speak to Midgard's pilots and are able to stop the attack on the Willgehm. The Gendarme and Willgehm both depart Sacktrager and head for the moon.

tvdb.title: Militia Space Showdown
tvdb.synopsis: Michael, Yanny and other members of the Militia are having a hard time getting used to space. Sochie and Kihel spend some quality time together. Yanny and other soldiers get drunk and try to return him to earth in a barrel forcing Loran to rescue him. Michael and Yanny then take Kihel hostage on the bridge, thinking she is Dianna. By sucking the air out of the bridge, they are forced to relent, but flee to the mobile suit deck where they take out to Borjanons and a Kapool. Loran and Harry go out to get them back.

tvdb.title: Gateway to the Moon
tvdb.synopsis: Cancer overhears Midgard plotting with Gym Ghingnham on killing Dianna. She and Muron try to rescue Dianna, heading out on a FLAT and a shuttle. Loran and Sochie ponder where to put the Turn A Gundam's hidden nuclear bombs. Dianna, Cancer and Muron head to the asteroid colony Mistletoe and send a signal to the Willghem. Loran decides that he will hide the nuclear bombs there. Gym discovers that Dianna is at Mistletoe. He launches a force led by Sweatson Stero. Harry heads off in his Sumo with Kihel. Loran and Sochie are attacked by Sweatson's forces and enter Mistletoe.

episodes.title: Warrior God Ghingnham

tvdb.title: Warrior God Ghingnham
tvdb.synopsis: Loran and Sochie are pursued by Sweatson and his Mahiroos, and Harry tries to stop them by saying he has rescued Dianna. Dianna, Cancer and Muron enter activate the asteroid's systems and fight off Sweatson's forces. They meet up with Loran, and Dianna convinces Cancer and Muron to trust him. Harry admits his love for Kihel and kisses her. The Willghem enters Mistletoe. Harry and Kihel meet up with Gym on the ship Aspite. Sweatson is given orders to attack. The Mahiroos try to lock the Willghem in Mistletoe, but everyone is able to escape before it is destroyed.

episodes.title: Shattering an Asteroid

tvdb.title: Shattering an Asteroid
tvdb.synopsis: The Willghem continues to depart from Mistletoe. Sweatson and his Mahiroos attack again. Guin speaks with Midgard, and Gym agrees to negotiate and get Agrippa involved. Part of Mistletoe is set to crash into Von City on the moon. Kihel demands Gym destroy it; he initially claims he doesn't have enough weapons, but then agrees to use the Turn X top. Loran plans to use the nuclear bombs stored in the Turn A Gundam to destroy the remains of Mistletoe. Gym recognizes the Turn A Gundam. Loran is successful in detonating the remains of the asteroid with the bombs. Cancer and Muron head back towards Earth in their FLAT.

episodes.title: Sea Battle on the Moon

tvdb.title: Sea Battle on the Moon
tvdb.synopsis: The Turn A Gundam and Kapool enter the moon. There they find a giant river and Loran meets up with his friends Donna and Hammett, who ride dolphins. They head to their house, where a crowd is excited to see Dianna. Guin, Michael and Lily meet with Gym, who says that he's more focused on the military and they should speak with Agrippa. Midgard tries to stab Harry, to no avail. Dianna hopes to head to the Moon capital of Gaingnham and they wonder if they can get there via the river. Working with cloth, giant disguises are made for the Turn A Gundam and Kapool to make them look like whales. Sweatson's group arrives at the Moon and starts searching for them. The Aspite and Willghem descend to Gaingnham. Whales appear, enabling Loran and the others to repel Sweatson's attack.

tvdb.title: The Decision to Fight
tvdb.synopsis: Loran and the others head down an industrial elevator to Gaingnham where Dianna hopes to meet with Gym and Agrippa. They meet back up with the Wilghem. Through Lily, they have obtained a meeting with Agrippa. Harry rescues Kihel on the Aspite. Sweatson is restless and heads out to find the Turn A Gundam. Bruno brings the Willghem in the city where he uses the city as a shield. Guin, Dianna and the others head into the palace where Guin claims she is Kihel and they encounter Agrippa. Upon seeing the city under attack, Agrippa requests help from Gym. Guin returns to the Willghem, upset at how this hurt negotiations. Guin thinks about negotiating with Gym and Agrippa directly. Sweatson demands the Turn A Gundam be turned over or he'll kill Guin, Lily and Dianna, causing them to get upset at Agrippa. Loran wonders what to do.

episodes.title: The Turn X Activates

tvdb.title: The Turn X Activates
tvdb.synopsis: Midgard holds Dianne, Guin and Lily hostage. Michael announces that the Willghem will destroy the city if the Moonrace tries to take the Turn A Gundam. Agrippa asks Gym to make Sweatson's Mahiroos retreat. Gym decides he'll use the Turn X, and contacts his subordinate Merrybell Gadget. Sweatson and Loran fight each other. Harry and Kihel enter the city. Agrippa tells Loran that if he fights the Turn X on the Moon's surface, the hostages will be released. Loran accepts. Agrippa thinks that by going to Earth, Dianna has rekindled the fighting spirit in the Moonrace and that she must be eliminated. Gym uses the city's power to start the Turn X. Midgard tries to kill Kihel but is stopped by the arrival of Dianna and Harry, and Guin's efforts. Agrippa escapes. The Turn X and Turn A Gundam meet each other on the Moon's surface.

episodes.title: The Shocking Dark History

tvdb.title: The Shocking Dark History
tvdb.synopsis: Gym tells Loran to hand over the Turn A Gundam, that it destroyed Earth's civilization and that he is protecting Dianna by destroying it. Merrybell joins in the battle on her Bandit. Gym is told that the Militia have taken Dianna's palace, but he doesn't care, leaving it up to Agrippa. Dianna, Agrippa and others head further underground where people are kept in cryogenic stasis. People are shocked when Dianna and Kihel reveal when they had switched places. Harry defends against an attack from Sweatson's Mahiroo squad. Dianna leads everyone into the Dark History room, which plays events from the past, including all previous Gundam shows, such as mobile suit battles and colony drops. Images of the Dark History start appearing throughout the area, including the city and the fight between Loran and Gym on the surface. Lastly, a video is shown of the Turn A Gundam using the Moonlight Butterly attack to destroy Earth's civilization.

tvdb.title: The Enemy Starts Anew
tvdb.synopsis: People continue to watch images of the Dark History. Dianna orders Agrippa to have the battle on the surface stopped and for his spies to leave Dianna Counter. Agrippa is scared over what will happen now that the Dark History has been revealed. The citizens of Gaingnham start rioting, including outside of Dianna's palace. Loran continues his battle with Gym and Merrybell. Dianna and Kihel try to stab Agrippa, but Midgard shoots him instead. The Willghem picks up everyone. Sweatson attacks in his Mahiroos. Dianna is worried about the billion people in stasis in this area. Guin asks Sid to copy all the information about the Dark History. Loran arrives and helps fight off Sweatson's attack. The Gendarme also appears and joins in the attack. Midgard rushes to escape, but Harry kills him. Dianna makes a speech to calm down the populace.

tvdb.title: Guin the Traitor
tvdb.synopsis: Kihel visits Harry in the hospital, in Dianna's clothes. A group of people are released from stasis, including Teteth's mother. Guin, Michael and Sid look over the records of the Dark History and think about mass producing their own mobile suits. Gym meets with Dianna, but refuses to hand over his mobile suits. Merrybell tries to kill Dianna but Gym has her stop, not knowing if its really her and they leave. Guin meets up with them. Dianna wants Loran to steal the Turn X from Gym. Guin decides to align himself with Gym and orders the Willghem to head to Earth such that he can restore the Earth using Moonrace technology. Loran flees, taking the Turn A Gundam with him. Gym attacks him with the Turn X as he leaves, and Loran is forced to escape in the core fighter.

tvdb.title: To Earth Once Again
tvdb.synopsis: The Willghem meets up with the Aspite and they head for Earth. Bruno and Jacop fail in their attempt to escape. More riots occur in the city and Dianna speaks to them once more about how she has to stop Gym, then everyone can return to Earth. Gym sends Zssan mobile suit forces to prevent Dianna from leaving. Harry and Loran work on defending against them. Afterwards, everyone boards the Almaiya and it takes off from the Moon.

tvdb.title: Ghingnham Invades
tvdb.synopsis: Sweatson's Mahiroo squad attacks cities on the Earth. Keith and his wife are caught up in the attack. The Almaiya enters the Earth's atmosphere. Guin meets with Keith and Horace, desiring for the Moonrace's help. Mahiroos attack the capital of Luziana. The Almaiya arrives, meeting up with Joseph, Fran, Keith and others. Dianna hopes to destroy the Turn a Gundam but they must defeat Gym to do so. Guin makes an announcement, and asks Loran how he can hope to defeat Gym without the Turn A Gundam, while Loran demands the Willghem be returned to Dianna. The Mahiroos launch an attack, against Guin's orders. Merrybell joins in on the attack, piloting the Turn A Gundam. Harry and others fight them off, forcing the Willghem to retreat.

tvdb.title: The Return of Dianna
tvdb.synopsis: Merrybell destroys a town with the Turn A Gundam's Moonlight Butterly system. Conflict arises between Guin and Gym since everyone in America now opposes Guin. Corin appears and tells them what Merrybell is doing. He bows before Dianna, willing to fight for her. Sweatson and his Mahiroo squad attack the Soleil. Dianna wants to join forces with Phil and Dianna Counter to defeat Gym. Loran, Sochie, Fran and Joseph go to the Willghem where they confront Guin. Bruno and Jacop escape from the ship. The Soleil and Almaiya attack. Joseph steals back the Turn A Gundam. The Soleil's crew gathers for Dianna, and Phil and Miran agree to follow her.

tvdb.title: Moonlight Butterfly
tvdb.synopsis: Merrybell and Sweatson lead an attack on the Almaiya. Bruno and Jacop join up with Harry. Joseph continues to pilot the Turn A Gundam and he fights Loran over it. Gym is angry that Guin lost the Turn A Gundam. Corin heads out to fight in a Kapool and joins Poe in fighting off Merrybell and Sweatson. Gym heads out in the Turn X. Harry also heads out in his Sumo. Joseph fights the Turn X but it starts drawing the Turn A's energy. Gym kills Sweatson when he interferes. Harry, Poe and others arrive and damage the Willghem then try to hold the Turn X in place. Gym activates the Moonlight Butterfly. Loran docks his core fighter with the Turn A Gundam and prepares for one final battle with Gym.

tvdb.title: Golden Autumn
tvdb.synopsis: Poe and Harry join up with the Soleil. Sochie and Miashei help out Corin with his Kapool. The Almaiya discovers the Turn A Gundam's location. The Willghem descends to the ground and Michael says he'll no longer follow Guin's orders. Loran fights Gym, who wants to use the Turn X to destroy civilization and begin things anew. He starts a Moonlight Butterfly attack. Corin fights off Merrybell, but is killed by Gym's attack. Loran activates the Moonlight Butterfly as well. The abandoned Guin rescues Merrybell and join up with Michael and Yanny. Sochie joins up with Harry and Poe in defending the Soleil, which activates its barrier. Loran slices into the Turn X, and Gym ejects the Turn X top. The two get out of their mobile suits and fight with swords. Gym is enveloped in a sealing light from the Turn A and Turn X while Loran is able to escape due to Sochie's help. With Gym permanently trapped, the war ends.
